What a very disappointing and altogether unpleasant experience. This will be my last review for 2024 and how unfortunate it is not a good one!
We made an appointment for our 7 year old Golden Retriever to have a basic grooming.
After picking up our Scott, when we got home we noticed our he had a really bad cut/scar and he was rubbing against the wall. He never showed this behavior before.
We called Maria, the owner and she right away was on the defensive yelling as us in Spanish. Maybe it is possible that this cut did not occur yesterday while our dog was at Maria's but what is NOT POSSIBLE is that no one noticed such a big red and ugly cut!!!

They should not have accepted our dog or at the very least pointed out to us that they noticed he had a really bad wound!
She claims she was not there and that they were very busy! This is not the reply we would expect.
If you love your dog, think twice and then think one more time before entrusting your pet to these uncaring and unprofessional people.

María never apologized, never offer any suggestions of what we can do New Year's Eve.

She was not even willing to offer a discount. Finally she just hung up on us. Not impressed and blown away.
